name: How can I prevent future bathroom sink clogs?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future bathroom sink clogs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing bathroom sink clogs involves adopting a few simple habits. Use a drain screen or hair catcher to prevent hair and debris from entering the drain. Avoid pouring grease or harsh chemicals down the sink. Regularly flush your drain with hot water. Periodically pour a mixture of baking soda and white vinegar into the drain, let it sit for 30 minutes, then flush with hot water. Being mindful of what goes down your drain can significantly reduce the frequency of clogs and the need for professional plumbing services.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent clogs by using drain screens, avoiding grease and harsh chemicals, and regularly flushing with hot water or a baking soda/vinegar solution.
